mentions.name: Unraid to Argo/Kubernetes services migration
mentions.description: This project migrates self-hosted services from an unraid server to an Argo-managed Kubernetes cluster, starting with services like Immich and PeerTube that are hard to keep up with using clickops.
mentions.problem: Some self-hosted services are hard to keep up with when managed via clickops on unraid.
mentions.source_excerpt: Getting ready to start a slow migration of some services from unraid to an argo/k8s cluster (starting with some services I don't use yet which are hard to keepup in clickops, immich,peertube, etc)

evidence.value: Getting ready to start a slow migration of some services from unraid to an argo/k8s cluster (starting with some services I don't use yet which are hard to keepup in clickops, immich,peertube, etc)
